operation.summary: From an installed applet's card: send one result to the applet's private web portal (the kind its package declares in ui.portal.records, e.g. a workout). Words and numbers only, never free text or pictures; it goes only while the owner has the applet's web portal on

body.name: label
body.description: One lowercase word (a-z, 0-9, _ or -), e.g. moderate

body.name: metrics
body.description: Up to 16 numbers under lowercase keys, e.g. {"score": 72, "calories": 9.4}

operation.returns: portal on (sent with the next push) | not_linked (kept until this device is linked to the portal account) | off (not sent: the owner hasn't turned the portal on), queued, record
